rule: delta_n > 0: rows arrived after seal, not attributable; otherwise attributable
how:
Per-trial late-row test for an E-C/E-D aggregate (same test as used for E-C auth
and E-PS). For every trial whose second-segment the aggregator flagged, recompute
that segment from the verifier's OWN saved recorder snapshot and the saved anchor
chain with the shipped monitor (scheme from HOMEPROV_SCHEME), and classify:
delta_n > 0 -> rows arrived after the seal (not attributable to the arm);
delta_n <= 0 or segment vanished -> attributable. Read-only; writes one new file.
Usage: late_row_check.py TAG SNAPSHOT_DB CHAIN_JSONL
